theorems.name: Submission.p02_es_177ebb5a_lcd_coeff_linear_combination
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (A : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n) →ₗ[ℂ] ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n)) (e : Fin 2 →₀ ℕ), ∃ c : Fin (n + 1) → ℂ, ∀ Q : ↥(HeckeEis.BinaryForm ℂ n), MvPolynomial.coeff e (A Q).val = ∑ r : Fin (n + 1), c r * MvPolynomial.coeff (Finsupp.single (0 : Fin 2) r.val + Finsupp.single (1 : Fin 2) (n - r.val)) Q.val
theorems.natural_summary: Expand a binary form into degree-n monomials, then apply the linear map and coefficient functional to obtain fixed coefficients independent of Q.
